name: Plumbing Contractor Business Intelligence System™
cta: Every month you wait is [another month of guessing.]
lines: hook
Monday, a water heater install. Tuesday, three drain calls. Wednesday, an emergency repipe.
hook
So here's the question. Which of those jobs actually made you [money?]
hook
Not the biggest invoice. The one that kept the most after labor and [materials.]
hook
Because one callback can erase the margin the original job was supposed to earn.
hook
And without job-level numbers, you don't see it until the year is already over.
